dīna-bandho jagat-pate
gopeśa gopikā-kānta
rādhā-kānta namo 'stu te
krsnāya vāsudevāya
devakī nandanāya ca
nanda gopa kumārāya
govindāya namo namaḥ
he kṛṣṇa govinda hare murāri
he natha nārāyaṇa vāsudeva
śri rāma nārāyaṇa he mukunda
lakṣmī pate keśava vāsudeva
hari hari haribol, hari hari hari bol
mukunda mādhava govinda bol
hari hari haribol, hari hari hari bol
mukunda mādhava keśava bol
gopāla gopāla yaśodā nandana gopāla
brahma bole catur mukha kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare
mahādeva pañca mukhe rāma rāma hare hare
Sita-Rama Tattva
raghu pati rāghava rājā rāma
patīta pāvana sītā rāma
sītā rāma sītā rāma sītā rāma jaya sītā rāmā
jaya raghu nandana jaya sīyā rāma
jānakī vallabha sītā rāma
śrī rāma jaya rāma jaya jaya rāma
jaya jaya rāma jaya jaya hanuman

songs.title: Jauvane Jakhona
songs.official: First Principle of Surrender: Dainya (Humility), Song 3
songs.first:
jauvane jakhona, dhana-upārjane,
hoinu vipula kāmī

songs.title: Suno Mor Duhkher Kahini
songs.official: First Principle of Surrender: Dainya (Humility), Song 5
songs.first:
(prabhu he!) śuno mor duḥkher kāhinī
viṣaya-halāhala, sudhā-bhāne piyaluṅ,

songs.title: Tuwa Pade E Minati Mor
songs.official: First Principle of Surrender: Dainya (Humility), Song 6
songs.first:
(prabhu he!) tuwā pade e minati mor
tuwā pada-pallava, tyajato maru-mana,

songs.title: Na Korolun Karama
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 1
songs.first:
nā koroluṅ karama, geyāna nāhi bhelo,
nā sevilun caraṇa tohār

songs.title: Kohobun Ki Sarama Ki Bat
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 2
songs.first:
(prāneśwar!) kohobuṅ ki sarama ki bāt
aichana pāp nāhi, jo hāma nā koraluṅ,

songs.title: Aham Mama Sabda Arthe
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 4
songs.first:
`ahaṁ mama’-śabda-arthe jāhā kichu hoy
arpiluṅ tomāra pade, ohe doyā-moy!

songs.title: Amara Bolite Prabhu
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 5
songs.first:
`āmāra’ bolite prabhu! āre kichu nāi
tumi-i āmāra mātra pitā-bandhu-bhāi

songs.title: Bastutah Sakali Tava
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 6
songs.first:
bastutaḥ sakali tava, jīva keho noy
`aham’-`mama’-bhrame bhromi’ bhoge śoka-bhoy

songs.title: Nivedana Kori Prabhu
songs.official: Second Principle of Surrender: Ātma-Nivedana (Dedication of the Self), Song 7
songs.first:
nivedana kori prabhu! tomāra caraṇe
patita adhama āmi, jāne tri-bhuvane

songs.title: Dara Putra Nija Deho
songs.official: Third Principle of Surrender: Goptṛtve-Varaṇa (Acceptance of the Lord as Sole Maintainer), Song 2
songs.first:
dārā-putra-nija-deho-kuṭumba-pālane
sarvadā vyākula āmi chinu mane mane

songs.title: Tumi To Maribe Jare
songs.official: Fourth Principle of Surrender: `Avaśya Rakṣibe Kṛṣṇa’—Viśvāsa, Pālana (Faith in Kṛṣṇa as Protector), Song 2
songs.first:
tumi to’ māribe jāre, ke tāre rākhite pāre,
icchā-baśa tribhuvan

songs.title: Atma Samarpane Gela Abhiman
songs.official: Fourth Principle of Surrender: `Avaśya Rakṣibe Kṛṣṇa’—Viśvāsa, Pālana (Faith in Kṛṣṇa as Protector), Song 3
songs.first:
ātma-samarpane gelā abhimān
nāhi korobuṅ nija rakhā-vidhān

songs.title: Chodato Purusa Abhiman
songs.official: Fourth Principle of Surrender: `Avaśya Rakṣibe Kṛṣṇa’—Viśvāsa, Pālana (Faith in Kṛṣṇa as Protector), Song 4
songs.first:
choḍato puruṣa-abhimān
kiṅkorī hoiluṅ āji, kān!

songs.title: Tuwa Bhakti Pratikula Dharma
songs.official: Fifth Principle of Surrender: Bhakti-Pratikūla-Bhāva Varjanāṅgīkāra (Renunciation of Conduct Unfavorable to Pure Devotion), Song 2
songs.first:
tuwā-bhakti-pratikūla dharma jā’te roy
parama jatane tāhā tyajibo niścoy

songs.title: Visaya Vimudha Ar Mayavadi Jan
songs.official: Fifth Principle of Surrender: Bhakti-Pratikūla-Bhāva Varjanāṅgīkāra (Renunciation of Conduct Unfavorable to Pure Devotion), Song 3
songs.first:
viṣaya-vimūḍha ār māyāvādī jan
bhakti-śūnya duṅhe prāna dhare akāraṇ

songs.title: Ami To Swananda Sukhada Basi
songs.official: Fifth Principle of Surrender: Bhakti-Pratikūla-Bhāva Varjanāṅgīkāra (Renunciation of Conduct Unfavorable to Pure Devotion), Song 4
songs.first:
āmi to’ swānanda-sukhada-bāsī
rādhikā-mādhava-caraṇa-dāsī

songs.title: Tuwa Bhakti Anukula
songs.official: Sixth Principle of Surrender: Bhakti-Anukūla-Mātra Kāryera Svīkara (Acceptance of Activities Favorable to Pure Devotion), Song 1
songs.first:
tuwā-bhakti-anukūla je-je kārya hoy
parama-jatane tāhā koribo niścoy

songs.title: Godruma Dhame Bhajana Anukule
songs.official: Sixth Principle of Surrender: Bhakti-Anukūla-Mātra Kāryera Svīkara (Acceptance of Activities Favorable to Pure Devotion), Song 2
songs.first:
godruma-dhāme bhajana-anukūle
māthura-śrī-nandīśvara-samatule

songs.title: Arthera Sancaye
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 2
songs.first:
hari he!
arthera sañcaye, viṣaya-prayāse,

songs.title: Bhajane Utsaha
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 3
songs.first:
hari he!
bhajane utsāha, bhaktite viśvāsa,

songs.title: Dana Pratigraha
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 4
songs.first:
hari he!
dāna, pratigraha, mitho gupta-kathā,

songs.title: Sanga Dosa Sunya
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 5
songs.first:
hari he!
saṅga-doṣa-śūnya, dīkṣitādīkṣita,

songs.title: Nira Dharma Gata
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 6
songs.first:
hari he!
nīra-dharma-gata, jāhnavī-salile,

songs.title: Tomare Bhuliya
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 8
songs.first:
hari he!
tomāre bhuliyā, avidyā-pīḍāya,

songs.title: Sri Rupa Gosai
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 9
songs.first:
hari he!
śrī-rūpa-gosāi, śrī-guru-rūpete,

songs.title: Kabe Mora Sei Din Habe
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 12
songs.first:
gurudev!
kabe mora sei din ha’be

songs.title: Kabe Tava Karuna Prakase
songs.official: Bhajana-Lālasā (Hankering for Divine Service), Song 13
songs.first:
gurudev!
kabe tava karunā-prakāśe

songs.title: Dekhite Dekhite
songs.official: Siddhi-Lālasā (Hankering for Spiritual Perfection), Song 2
songs.first:
dekhite dekhite, bhulibo vā kabe,
nija-sthūla-paricoya

songs.title: Brsabhanu Suta Carana Sevane
songs.official: Siddhi-Lālasā (Hankering for Spiritual Perfection), Song 3
songs.first:
bṛṣabhānu-sutā- caraṇa-sevane,
hoibo ye pālya-dāsī

songs.title: Krsna Nama Dhare Koto Bal
songs.official: Śrī Nāma-Māhātmya (The Glories of the Holy Name)
songs.first:
kṛṣṇa-nāma dhare koto bal
viṣaya-vāsanānale, mora citta sadā jwale,

songs.title: Sacir Angane Kabhu
songs.official: Prasād-Sevāya (During the Honoring of Spiritual Food), Song 3
songs.first:
bhāi-re!
śacīr aṅgane kabhu, mādhavendra-purī prabhu,

songs.title: Sri Caitanya Nityananda
songs.official: Prasād-Sevāya (During the Honoring of Spiritual Food), Song 4
songs.first:
bhāi-re!
śrī-caitanya nityānanda, śrīvāsādi bhakta-vṛnda,

songs.title: Eka Dina Nilacale
songs.official: Prasād-Sevāya (During the Honoring of Spiritual Food), Song 5
songs.first:
bhāi-re!
eka-dina nīlācale, prasād-sevana-kāle,

songs.title: Rama Krsna Gocarane
songs.official: Prasād-Sevāya (During the Honoring of Spiritual Food), Song 6
songs.first:
bhāi-re!
rāma-kṛṣṇa gocāraṇe, jaibena dūra vane,

songs.title: Ekbar Bhavo Mane
songs.official: Śrī Nagar-Kīrtan (Congregational Chanting in Public Places), Song 3 (Śrī-Nāma)
songs.first:
ekbār bhāvo mane,
āśā-baśe bhrami' hethā pā'be ki sukha jīvane

songs.title: Anga Upanga Astra Parsada Sange
songs.official: Śrī Nagar-Kīrtan (Congregational Chanting in Public Places), Song 6 (Śrī-Nāma)
songs.first:
aṅga-upāṅga-astra-pārṣada saṅge
nāco-i bhāva-mūrati gorā raṅge

songs.title: Nitai Ki Nam Eneche Re
songs.official: Śrī Nagar-Kīrtan (Congregational Chanting in Public Places), Song 7 (Śrī-Nāma)
songs.first:
hare kṛṣṇa hare
nitāi ki nām eneche re

songs.title: Hari Bole Modera Gaura Elo
songs.official: Śrī Nagar-Kīrtan (Congregational Chanting in Public Places), Song 8 (Śrī-Nāma)
songs.first:
‘hari’ bole’ modera gaura elo
elo re gaurāṅga-cānda preme elothelo

songs.title: Nadiya Nagare Nitai Nece Nece Gay Re
songs.official: Śrīman Mahāprabhur Śata-Nāma (One Hundred Names of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu), Song 1
songs.first:
nadīyā-nagare nitāi nece' nece' gāy re
jagannātha-suta mahāprabhu viśvambhara

songs.title: Jaya Godruma Pati Gora
songs.official: Śrīman Mahāprabhur Śata-Nāma (One Hundred Names of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu), Song 2
songs.first:
jaya godruma-pati gorā
nitāi-jīvana, advaitera dhana,

songs.title: Kali Yuga Pavana Visvambhara
songs.official: Śrīman Mahāprabhur Śata-Nāma (One Hundred Names of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu), Song 3
songs.first:
kali-yuga-pāvana viśvambhara
gauḍa-citta-gagaṇa-śaśadhara

songs.title: Krsna Caitanya Advaita Prabhu Nityananda
songs.official: Śrīman Mahāprabhur Śata-Nāma (One Hundred Names of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu), Song 4
songs.first:
kṛṣṇa-caitanya advaita prabhu nityānanda
gadādhara śrīnivāsa murāri mukunda

songs.title: Nagare Nagare Gora Gay
songs.official: Śrī Kṛṣṇaer Viṁśottara-Śata-Nām (One Hundred and Twenty Names of Lord Kṛṣṇa), Song 1
songs.first:
nagare nagare gorā gāy
yaśomatī-stanya-pāyī śrī-nanda-nandana

songs.title: Krsna Govinda Hare
songs.official: Śrī Kṛṣṇaer Viṁśottara-Śata-Nām (One Hundred and Twenty Names of Lord Kṛṣṇa), Song 2
songs.first:
kṛṣṇa govinda hare
gopī-vallabha śaure

songs.title: Radha Vallabha Madhava Sri Pati
songs.official: Śrī Kṛṣṇaer Viṁśottara-Śata-Nām (One Hundred and Twenty Names of Lord Kṛṣṇa), Song 3
songs.first:
rādhā-vallabha, mādhava, śrī-pati, mukunda
gopīnātha, madana-mohana, rāsa-rasānanda

songs.title: Radha Vallabha Radha Vinoda
songs.official: Śrī Kṛṣṇaer Viṁśottara-Śata-Nām (One Hundred and Twenty Names of Lord Kṛṣṇa), Song 5
songs.first:
rādhā-vallabha, rādhā-vinoda
rādhā-mādhava, rādhā-pramoda

songs.title: Jaya Yasoda Nandana Krsna Gopala Govinda
songs.official: Śrī Kṛṣṇaer Viṁśottara-Śata-Nām (One Hundred and Twenty Names of Lord Kṛṣṇa), Song 6
songs.first:
jaya yaśodā-nandana kṛṣṇa gopāla govinda
jaya madana-mohana hare ananta mukunda

songs.title: Haraye Namah Krsna Yadavaya Namah
songs.official: Śrī Nām-Kīrtan (Chanting of the Holy Names), Song 5
songs.first:
(hare) haraye namaḥ kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ
yādavāya mādhavāya keśavāya namaḥ

songs.title: Krsna Bhakti Vina Kabhu Nahi Phalodoy
songs.official: Śreyo-Nirṇaya (Ascertainment of Spiritual Welfare), Song 1
songs.first:
kṛṣṇa-bhakti vinā kabhu nāhi phalodoy
miche sab dharmādharma jīver upādhimoy

songs.title: Piriti Sac Cid Anande Rupavati Nari
songs.official: Śreyo-Nirṇaya (Ascertainment of Spiritual Welfare), Song 3
songs.first:
pīriti sac-cid-ānande rūpavatī nārī
dayā-dharma-ādi guna alaṅkāra sab tāhāri

songs.title: Nirakar Nirakar Koriya Citkar
songs.official: Śreyo-Nirṇaya (Ascertainment of Spiritual Welfare), Song 4
songs.first:
`nirākār nirākār', koriyā cītkār
keno sādhaker śānti bhāṅgo, bhāi, bār bār

songs.title: Keno Ar Koro Dvesa
songs.official: Śreyo-Nirṇaya (Ascertainment of Spiritual Welfare), Song 5
songs.first:
keno ār koro dveṣa, videśi-jana-bhajane
bhajanera liṅga nānā, nānā deśe nānā jane

songs.title: Bhavo Na Bhavo Na Mana
songs.official: Bhajan-Gītā (Songs for Worship), Song 2
songs.first:
bhāvo nā bhāvo nā, mana, tumi ati duṣṭa
kāma-krodha-lobha-moha-madādi-āviṣṭa

songs.title: Sri Rupa Vadane Sri Saci Kumar
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 1 [Lalita—Ekatālā & Daśakuśī]
songs.first:
śrī-rūpa-vadane śrī-śacī-kumār
swa-nām-mahimā koralo pracār

songs.title: Jaya Jaya Harinam Cidanandamrta Dham
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 2 [Lalita—Daśakuśī]
songs.first:
jaya jaya harinām, cidānandāmṛta-dhām,
para-tattva akṣara-ākār

songs.title: Visve Udita Nama Tapan
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 3 [Vibhāṣa—Ekatālā]
songs.first:
viśve udita, nāma-tapan,
avidyā-vināśa lāgi'

songs.title: Jnani Jnana Yoge Koriya Jatane
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 4 [Lalita—Daśakuśī]
songs.first:
jñānī jñāna-yoge, koriyā jatane,
brahmera sākṣāt kore

songs.title: Harinam Tuwa Aneka Swarup
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 5 [Lalita-Vibhāṣa—Ekatālā]
songs.first:
harinām, tuwā aneka swarūp
yaśodā-nandana, ānanda-vardhana,

songs.title: Vacya O Vacaka Dui Swarup Tomar
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 6 [Vibhāṣa—Jhāṅphi, Lophā]
songs.first:
vācya o vācaka—dui swarūp tomār
vācya—tava śrī-vigraha cid-ānandākār

songs.title: Ohe Harinam Tava Mahima Apar
songs.official: Śrī Nāmāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers Glorifying the Holy Name), Song 7 [Lalita Jhiṅjhiṭa—Ekatālā]
songs.first:
ohe harinām, tava mahimā apār
tava pade nati āmi kori bār bār

songs.title: Radhika Carana Padma
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 1
songs.first:
rādhikā-caraṇa-padma, sakala śreyera sadma,
jatane je nāhi ārādhilo

songs.title: Virajar Pare Suddha Paravyoma Dham
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 2
songs.first:
virajār pāre śuddha-paravyoma-dhām
tad upari śrī-gokula-bṛndāraṇya nām

songs.title: Ramani Siromani Brsabhanu Nandini
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 3
songs.first:
ramaṇī-śiromaṇi, bṛṣabhānu-nandinī,
nīla-vasana-paridhāna

songs.title: Rasika Nagari Gana Siromani
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 4
songs.first:
rasika nāgarī- gaṇa-śiromaṇi,
kṛṣṇa-preme sarahaṁsī

songs.title: Mahabhava Cintamani
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 5
songs.first:
mahābhāva-cintāmaṇi, udbhāvita tanu-khāni,
sakhī-pati-sajjā prabhāvatī

songs.title: Baraja Bipine Jamuna Kule
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 6
songs.first:
baraja-bipinejamunā-kūle
mañca manoharaśobhita phule

songs.title: Sata Koti Gopi Madhava Man
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 7
songs.first:
śata-koṭi gopīmādhava-man
rākhite nārilokori' jatan

songs.title: Radha Bhajane Jadi Mati Nahi Bhela
songs.official: Śrī Rādhāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers in Glorification of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī), Song 8
songs.first:
rādha-bhajane jadi mati nāhi bhelā
kṛṣṇa-bhajana tava akāraṇa gelā

songs.title: Bhojana Lalase Rasane Amar
songs.official: Pariśiṣṭa (Supplementary Poem)
songs.first:
bhojana-lālase, rasane āmār,
śunoha vidhāna mor

songs.title: Pita Varana Kali Pavana Gora
songs.official: Śrī Śikṣāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers of Divine Instruction), Song 1 [Jhāṅphi—Lophā]
songs.first:
pīta-varaṇa kali-pāvana gorā
gāoyāi aichana bhāva-vibhorā

songs.title: Tunhu Doya Sagara Tarayite Prani
songs.official: Śrī Śikṣāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers of Divine Instruction), Song 2
songs.first:
tuṅhu doyā-sāgara tārayite prāṇī
nām aneka tuwā śikhāoli āni'

songs.title: Aparadha Phale Mama
songs.official: Śrī Śikṣāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers of Divine Instruction), Song 6 [Choṭa-Daśakuśī—Lophā]
songs.first:
aparādha-phale mama, citta bhelo vajra-sama,
tuwā nāme nā labhe vikār

songs.title: Gaite Gaite Nama Ki Dasa Hoilo
songs.official: Śrī Śikṣāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers of Divine Instruction), Song 7 [Jhāṅphi—Lophā]
songs.first:
gāite gāite nāma ki daśā hoilo
`kṛṣṇa-nitya-dāsa mui' hṛdoye sphurilo

songs.title: Bandhu Gan Sunoha Vacana Mor
songs.official: Śrī Śikṣāṣṭaka (Eight Prayers of Divine Instruction), Song 8 [Daśakuśī]
songs.first:
bandhu-gaṇ! śunoha vacana mor
bhāvete vibhora, thākiye jakhon,

songs.title: Radha Krsna Nibedana Ei Jana Kore
songs.official: Samprarthanatmika (Appeal), Song 2
songs.first:
radha-krsna nibedana ei jana kore
donhe ati rasamaya sa-karuna-hrdaya

songs.title: Hari Hari Ki Mora Karama Gati Manda
songs.official: Dainya-bodhika (The Author Describes His Fallen Condition), Song 3
songs.first:
hari hari ki mora karama-gati manda
braje radha-krsna-pada na bhajinu tila-ardha

songs.title: Praneswara Nibedana Ei Jana Kore
songs.official: Dainya-bodhika (The Author Describes His Fallen Condition), Song 5
songs.first:
praneswara nibedana ei jana kore
govinda gokulacandra parama ananda-kanda

songs.title: Hari Hari Krpa Kari Rakha Nija Pade
songs.official: Dainya-bodhika (The Author Describes His Fallen Condition), Song 6
songs.first:
hari hari krpa kari' rakha nija-pade
kama krodha chaya jane lana phire nana sthane

songs.title: Hari Hari Bada Sela Marame Rahila
songs.official: Dainya-bodhika (The Author Describes His Fallen Condition), Song 7
songs.first:
hari hari bada sela marame rahila
paiya durlabha tanu sri-krsna-bhajan binu

songs.title: Hari Hari Ki Mora Karama Abhaga
songs.official: Dainya-bodhika prarthana (Prayer Wherein the Author Describes His Fallen Condition), Song 8
songs.first:
hari hari ki mora karama abhaga
biphale jibana gela hrdaye rahila sela

songs.title: Hari Hari Hena Dina Haibe Amara
songs.official: Swabhista-lalasa (Longings), Song 9
songs.first:
hari hari hena dina haibe amara
dunhu anga parasiba hunhu anga nirakhiba

songs.title: Hari Hari Kabe Mora Haibe Su Dine
songs.official: Swabhista-lalasa (Longings), Song 10
songs.first:
hari hari kabe mora haibe su-dine
keli-kautuka-range kariba sebane

songs.title: Gobardhana Giri Bare
songs.official: Swabhista-lalasa (Longings), Song 11
songs.first:
gobardhana giri-bare kebala nirjana sthala
rai kanu karibe sayane

songs.title: Hari Hari Ara Ki Emana Dasa
songs.official: Swabhista-lalasa (Longings), Song 12
songs.first:
hari hari ara ki emana dasa
kabe brsabhanu-pure ahiri gopera ghare

songs.title: Hari Hari Ara Ki Emana Dasa Haba
songs.official: Swabhista-lalasa (Longings), Song 13
songs.first:
hari hari ara ki emana dasa haba
chadiya purusa--deha kabe ba prakrti haba

songs.title: Hari Hari Kabe Mora Haibe Sudina Gobardhana Giri Bare
songs.official: Punah Svabhista-lalasa (The Author Continues the Description of His Longings, Song 15
songs.first:
hari hari kabe mora haibe sudina
gobardhana giri-bare parama nibhrta ghare

songs.title: Ei Naba Dasi Bali Sri Rupa Cahibe
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 18
songs.first:
ei naba-dasi bali sri-rupa cahibe
hena subha-ksana mora kati-dine habe

songs.title: Sri Rupa Pascate Ami Rahiba Bhita Hana
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 19
songs.first:
sri-rupa pascate ami rahiba bhita hana
donhe punah kahibena ama pane cana

songs.title: Ha Ha Prabhu Lokanatha Rakha Pada Dwandwe
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 20
songs.first:
ha ha prabhu lokanatha rakha pada--dwandwe
krpa-drste caha jadi haiya anande

songs.title: Lokanatha Prabhu Tumi Daya Kara More
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 21
songs.first:
lokanatha prabhu tumi daya kara more
radha-krsna-carana jena sada citte sphure

songs.title: Ha Ha Prabhu Kara Daya Karuna Tomara
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 22
songs.first:
ha ha prabhu kara daya karuna tomara
micha maya-jale tanu dahiche amara

songs.title: Hari Hari Kabe Hena Dasa Habe Mora
songs.official: Lalasa (Longings), Song 23
songs.first:
hari hari kabe hena dasa habe mora
sebiba donhara pada anande bibhora

songs.title: Hari Hari Ara Ki Emana Dasa Haba Ei Bhaba Samsara
songs.official: Sadhaka-dehocita-Sri-brndabana-basa-lalasa (The Devotee's Aspiration to Reside in Sri Vrndavana), Song 26
songs.first:
hari hari ara ki emana dasa haba
ei bhaba samsara tyaji' parama anande maji'

songs.title: Hari Hari Ara Kabe Palatibe Dasa
songs.official: Sadhaka-dehocita-Sri-brndabana-basa-lalasa (The Devotee's Aspiration to Reside in Sri Vrndavana), Song 27
songs.first:
hari hari ara kabe palatibe dasa
e saba kariya bame jaba brndabana-dhame

songs.title: Karanga Kaupina Lana
songs.official: Sadhaka-dehocita-Sri-brndabana-basa-lalasa (The Devotee's Aspiration to Reside in Sri Vrndavana), Song 28
songs.first:
karanga kaupina lana chenda kanha gaya diya
tejagiba sakala bisaya

songs.title: Hari Hari Kabe Haba Brndabana Basi
songs.official: Sadhaka-dehocita-Sri-brndabana-basa-lalasa (The Devotee's Aspiration to Reside in Sri Vrndavana), Song 29
songs.first:
hari hari kabe haba brndabana-basi
nirakhiba nayane jugala-rupa-rasi

songs.title: Ara Ki Emana Dasa Haba
songs.official: Sa-bilapa Sri -brndabana-basa-lalasa (Lamentation and Yearning to Reside in Sri Vrndavana), Song 30
songs.first:
ara ki emana dasa haba
saba chadi' brndabane jaba

songs.title: Kabe Krsna Dhana Paba
songs.official: Mathura-virahocita Darsana-lalasa (The Author Yearns to Again see Mathura), Song 31
songs.first:
kabe krsna-dhana paba hiyara majhare thoba
judaiba tapita-parana

songs.title: Ei Bara Paile Dekha Carana Du Khani
songs.official: Mathura-virahocita Darsana-lalasa (The Author Yearns to Again see Mathura), Song 32
songs.first:
ei-bara paile dekha carana du' khani
hiyara majhare rakhi' juda'ba parani

songs.title: Kadamba Tarura Dala
songs.official: Mathura-virahocita Darsana-lalasa (The Author Yearns to Again see Mathura), Song 34
songs.first:
kadamba tarura dala namiyache bhume bhala
phutiyache phula sari sari

songs.title: Mrgamada Candana Kare Kari Sakhi Gana
songs.official: Mathura-virahocita Darsana-lalasa (The Author Yearns to Again see Mathura), Song 35
songs.first:
mrgamada-candana kare kari' sakhi-gana
barikhaye phula gandha-raje

songs.title: Hari Hari Ki Mora Karama Anurata
songs.official: Aksepa (regret), Song 43
songs.first:
hari hari ki mora karama anurata
bisaye kutila-mati sat-sange na haila rati

songs.title: Radha Krsna Sebon Muni Jibane Marane
songs.official: Sri - rupa-rati manjaryah Vijnaptih (Prayer to Sri Rupa manjari and Sri Rati-manjari), Song 48
songs.first:
radha-krsna-sebon muni jibane marane
tanra sthana tanra lila dekhon ratri dine

songs.title: Praneswari Ei Bara Karuna Kara More
songs.official: Siddha-dehena Sri -vrndavanaisvaryam saksad-vijnaptih (The Author Prays to Attain a Spiritual body in Sri Vrndavana-dhama), Song 50
songs.first:
praneswari ei bara karuna kara more
dasanete trna dhari' anjali mastake kari'

songs.title: Aruna Kamala Dale Sesa Bichaiba
songs.official: Siddha-dehena Sri -vrndavanaisvaryam saksad-vijnaptih (The Author Prays to Attain a Spiritual body in Sri Vrndavana-dhama), Song 51
songs.first:
aruna-kamala-dale sesa bichaiba
basaiba kisora-kisori

songs.title: Prabhu He Ei Bara Karaha Karuna
songs.official: Sri Krsne Vijnaptih (Prayer to Sri Krsna), Song 52
songs.first:
prabhu he ei-bara karaha karuna
jugala-carana dekhi saphala kariba ankhi

songs.title: Aji Rase Badara Nisi
songs.official: Sri Krsne Vijnaptih (Prayer to Sri Krsna), Song 53
songs.first:
aji rase badara nisi
preme bhasala saba brndabana-basi

songs.title: Anya Abhilasa Chadi Jnana Karma Parihari
songs.official: Song 2
songs.first:
śrīmad-rūpa-gosvāmi-prabhupādenoktam’-
anyābhilāṣitā-śūnyaṁ

songs.title: Tumi Ta Dayara Sindhu
songs.official: Song 3
songs.first:
tumi tā' dayāra sindhuadhama-janera bandhu
more prabhu kara abadhana

songs.title: Ana Katha Ana Byatha
songs.official: Song 4
songs.first:
āna kathā āna byathānāhi jena jāi tathā
tomāra caraṇa smṛti-majhe

songs.title: Ragera Bhajana Patha
songs.official: Song 5
songs.first:
rāgera bhajana-pathakahi ebe abhimata
loka-beda-sāra ei bāṇī

songs.title: Jugala Carana Prati
songs.official: Song 6
songs.first:
jugala-caraṇa-pratiparama-ānanda tati
rati-prema hau para-bandhe

songs.title: Radha Krsna Karon Dhyana
songs.official: Song 7
songs.first:
rādhā-kṛṣṇa karoṇ dhyānaswapane na bala āna
prema binu ara nāhi cāña

songs.title: Bacanera Agocara
songs.official: Song 8
songs.first:
bacanera agocarabṛndābana dhāma-bara
swaprakāśa premānanda-ghana

songs.title: Ana Katha Na Suniba
songs.official: Song 9
songs.first:
āna kathā na śunibaāna kathā na baliba
sakali kahiba paramārtha

songs.title: Prabho Krsna Caitanya
songs.official: Song 1
songs.first:
prabho kṛṣṇa-caitanya gauraṅga viśvambhara śrī-śacī-nandana prema-sindho
hare kṛṣṇa gopala govinda nandatmaja goṣṭha-gopī-jana-praṇa-bandho

songs.title: Payaya Krpaya Prema Sudham
songs.official: Song 2
songs.first:
payaya kṛpaya prema-sudhaṁ maṁ karaya nija-sevaṁ bahudha mam
śrī-govinda madana-gopala gopīnatha

songs.title: Vande Vrsabhanusuta Pada
songs.official: Song 3 (rāga-kānaḍā)
songs.first:
vande vṛṣabhanusuta-pada
kamala-nayana locana-sampada

songs.title: Iha Nava Vanjula Kunje
songs.official: Song 4 (Rāga-tuḍi)
songs.first:
iha nava-vañjula-kuñje
kurubaka-kusuma-susama-nava-guñje

songs.title: Sundari Kalaya Sapadi Nija Caritam
songs.official: Song 5 (Kedāra-rāga)
songs.first:
sundari kalaya sapadi nija-caritam
tvam atanu-karmaṇa-viduṣi rasikam amum akarṣasi guṇa-kalitam

songs.title: Ma Tuda Munca Patantam
songs.official: Song 6 (Varāḍi-rāga)
songs.first:
ma tuda muñca paṭantam iti sphuṭa-kuṭila-mukhaṁ smita-miśram
ṣaḍavam iva prīti-śrita-bhuja-bala-raśir agharir akṛṣṭam

songs.title: Hari Bhuja Kalita Madhura Mrdulanga
songs.official: Song 7
songs.first:
hari-bhuja-kalita-madhura-mṛdulaṅga
tad amala-mukha-śaśi-vilasad-apaṅga

songs.title: Krsna Nanda Gopa Nandana
songs.official: Song 8 (Dakṣiṇā-rāga)
songs.first:
kṛṣṇa nanda-gopa-nandana
jaya kṛṣṇa-manda-hasya-vadana

songs.title: Madhura Gokulanandana
songs.official: Song 9 (Śrirāga-vihāgaḍā)
songs.first:
madhura gokulanandana chavila-vṛndavana-candra
muralīdhara madhusudana madhava gopīnatha mukunda

songs.title: Jaya Madhurya Patake Sri Radhe
songs.official: Song 10
songs.first:
jaya madhurya-patake śrī-radhe
jaya vṛṣabhanu-sute

songs.title: Nanda Suno Krsna Govinda
songs.official: Song 11
songs.first:
nanda-suno kṛṣṇa govinda dṛśamayi diśi mayi nija-kṛpaya
maṁ jīvaya manda-smita-sudhaya

songs.title: Sarac Candra Bhrantim
songs.official: Śrī-Nityānandāṣṭaka — Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura
songs.first:
sarac-candra-bhrāntiṁ sphurad-amala-kāntiṁ gaja-gatiṁ
hari-premonmattaṁ dhṛta-parama-sattvaṁ smita-mukham
